data.title: The ruling
data.text: One Frame type in the harness: { uiData, theme, world, storage, fixtures, routes, args? }. A ui_snapshot, a ui_live_play_step and a component fixture each build one; playFeed.load takes it. The separators and the signed-in persona are the play's data over the frame, drawn by the frame.

data.title: Open
data.text: Which document hosts a tool drawing made of product components? The tool's document has no theme; the product's theme wrote a reset on every svg.
a component fixture is a named set of args

data.title: Later, not now
data.text: Passing a value between two screens: a document that writes the mock storage, the other reads it. The convention is written when it is needed.
